<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Autotune FlashInfer CuTeDSL MegaMoE at startup and reuse fixed live-token
workspaces during serving, without requiring an offline tuning cache.

## Claims

- Tune once per geometry/bucket; share knobs across layers and cache across restarts.
- Select workspaces using the EP-wide maximum token count.
- Prepare before CUDA Graph capture and account for retained memory before KV sizing.

## Validation

- Prior profile/cache suite: **88 passed** on `d13d944d6`.
  This logging/helper cleanup passed scoped pre-commit; pytest/GPU runs were not repeated.
  Suite: `uv run --active python -m pytest tests/model_executor/test_flashinfer_autotune_warmup.py -q`.
- GB200 EP4: **96** changed-input graph comparisons passed, including idle/uneven
  ranks and both output ownership modes. Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4, DP4/EP4/TP1,
  D16/P1024: four MRV1/MRV2 startups passed capture and **37/37** requests each;
  GSM8K **89–90.5% on 200 questions**. Cold/restart startup: **450/170 s**,
  knob searches **6/0**. These runs used the feature source with reused native
  extensions; current-head serving was not rerun.

**M3.1 operator perf — 8×GB200, EP8, NVFP4 W4A4.** Actual layer-3 weights,
synthetic activations/routing, H6144/I3072/E128/top4. FlashInfer 0.7.3rc1,
Torch 2.14.0+cu130, CuTeDSL 4.8.

**Experimental:** measured on `1a02c0262ba9` plus M3 wiring and packed-input fixes
**outside this PR**; this does not establish current-PR M3 serving support.

A = fixed workspace; B = buckets with identical knobs; C = buckets + autotune.
B/C decode capacity is 512. A/B use compatible N128 knobs because stock N256
fails compilation for this workload.

| Baseline capacity | Rows/rank | A fixed (µs) | B bucket (µs) | C tuned (µs) | A/C speedup [95% CI] |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 512 | 8 | 142.02 | 140.87 | 134.27 | 1.0578× [1.0563, 1.0584] |
| 512 | 16 | 144.98 | 146.32 | 137.93 | 1.0505× [1.0503, 1.0523] |
| 512 | 32 | 147.21 | 146.41 | 139.16 | 1.0580× [1.0566, 1.0609] |
| 512 | 64 | 151.18 | 151.74 | 141.87 | 1.0656× [1.0650, 1.0669] |
| 512 | 128 | 157.58 | 157.83 | 147.58 | 1.0681× [1.0664, 1.0690] |
| 512 | 256 | 175.47 | 175.24 | 171.87 | 1.0212× [1.0195, 1.0220] |
| 512 | 384 | 192.79 | 192.51 | 194.46 | 0.9914× [0.9898, 0.9925] |
| 512 | 512 | 207.66 | 208.06 | 208.05 | 0.9981× [0.9973, 0.9995] |
| 16,384 | 8 | 257.20 | 142.54 | 133.47 | 1.9273× [1.9254, 1.9291] |
| 16,384 | 16 | 261.11 | 148.07 | 138.18 | 1.8894× [1.8875, 1.8915] |
| 16,384 | 32 | 262.48 | 148.56 | 139.76 | 1.8790× [1.8759, 1.8808] |
| 16,384 | 64 | 263.95 | 152.67 | 141.52 | 1.8655× [1.8644, 1.8669] |
| 16,384 | 128 | 270.92 | 160.75 | 146.33 | 1.8517× [1.8493, 1.8533] |
| 16,384 | 256 | 285.06 | 177.16 | 172.16 | 1.6559× [1.6536, 1.6567] |
| 16,384 | 384 | 300.59 | 193.52 | 192.73 | 1.5590× [1.5573, 1.5618] |
| 16,384 | 512 | 314.02 | 210.21 | 207.29 | 1.5150× [1.5139, 1.5163] |

At equal capacity, buckets alone are approximately flat; autotune reduces
latency **4.8–6.4% at 8–128 rows** and **2.1% at 256**, with **0.87%/0.19%
regressions at 384/512**. The 16K baseline's larger gain mainly comes from
reducing capacity.

Timings include staging + distributed MoE + reduction: 12 randomized paired
epochs × 50 graph replays, EP-maximum duration, 2,000 bootstrap resamples.
**3,056 correctness checks passed**, with zero full-output A/B/C numerical
difference. Repeated warm-layer timing with fixed routing excludes E2E serving.
The experimental harness is not in this PR.

## Details

Requires the knob/workspace APIs in
[FlashInfer 0.7.3rc1](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/releases/tag/v0.7.3rc1);
the unchanged 0.7.2.post1 pin falls back to the default path.
Requires EP=WORLD, PCP1, no elastic EP or sleep mode. W4A16 is outside scope.

Related [#62073](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62073) adds Beam/decode
workspace integration; this adds per-bucket knob search, persistent cache and
pre-KV memory accounting. No E2E performance or memory-saving claim; failed
FlashInfer tuning candidates retained allocations until exit in the M3 experiment.
AI assistance was used.

@@ -5,6 +5,9 @@
 import sys
 from collections import defaultdict
 from contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext
+from copy import deepcopy
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import Enum
 from inspect import signature
 from pathlib import Path
 from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
@@ -90,6 +93,353 @@ def test_flashinfer_autotune_token_counts_are_bounded_and_deduplicated():
     assert token_counts == (32,)
 
 
+@pytest.fixture
+def megamoe_profiles(monkeypatch):
+    """Record the external FlashInfer service around a real vLLM profile owner."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles import (
+        FlashInferMoeEpProfiles,
+    )
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class ProfileInputs:
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor
+        scales: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        output: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+        @property
+        def num_tokens(self) -> int:
+            return self.hidden_states.shape[0]
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class Bootstrap:
+        world_size: int = 2
+        rank: int = 0
+        process_group: object = object()
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class Fleet:
+        num_experts: int = 8
+        token_hidden_size: int = 4
+        max_tokens_per_rank: int = 128
+        tuning_live_tokens: int | None = None
+
+    class FinalizeMode(Enum):
+        SINGLE_CTA = "single_cta"
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class Kernel:
+        intermediate_size: int = 8
+        finalize_mode: FinalizeMode = FinalizeMode.SINGLE_CTA
+        knobs: str | None = None
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class Backend:
+        megakernel: Kernel = Kernel()
+        quantize_input: bool = True
+        preprocess_weights: bool = False
+        transformed_weights: object = object()
+
+    class RecordingLayer:
+        instances: list["RecordingLayer"] = []
+        tuned: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
+        fail_profile: tuple[int, int] | None = None
+
+        def __init__(self, bootstrap, fleet, weights, backend):
+            assert weights is None
+            assert not backend.preprocess_weights
+            self.bootstrap, self.fleet, self.backend = bootstrap, fleet, backend
+            self.warmed_workspaces = []
+            self.selected_workspaces = []
+            self.workspace_knobs = {}
+            self.destroyed = False
+            self.instances.append(self)
+
+        def create_workspace(self, capacity, *, live_tokens, knobs):
+            workspace = (capacity, live_tokens)
+            # The native backend consumes tuple-valued shape knobs, including
+            # when the selected configuration came from a JSON cache.
+            assert isinstance(knobs["tile_shape"], tuple)
+            assert isinstance(knobs["cluster_shape"], tuple)
+            self.workspace_knobs[workspace] = knobs
+            return workspace
+
+        def warmup(self, inputs, *, workspace=None):
+            if self.backend.megakernel.knobs == "auto":
+                profile = (
+                    self.fleet.max_tokens_per_rank,
+                    self.fleet.tuning_live_tokens,
+                )
+                assert inputs.num_tokens == profile[1]
+                assert self.backend.transformed_weights is Backend.transformed_weights
+                self.tuned.append(profile)
+                if profile == self.fail_profile:
+                    raise RuntimeError("external tuner failed")
+            else:
+                assert inputs.num_tokens == workspace[1]
+                self.warmed_workspaces.append(workspace)
+
+        def get_tuned_knobs(self):
+            return {
+                "tile_shape": (64, 128),
+                "cluster_shape": (1, 2, 1),
+                "num_stages": self.fleet.tuning_live_tokens % 3 + 1,
+            }
+
+        def forward(self, inputs, *, workspace, return_workspace_view):
+            assert not return_workspace_view
+            assert workspace in self.warmed_workspaces
+            self.selected_workspaces.append(workspace)
+            return inputs.hidden_states
+
+        def destroy(self):
+            self.destroyed = True
+
+    def inputs(num_tokens):
+        return ProfileInputs(
+            hidden_states=torch.zeros(num_tokens, 4),
+            topk_ids=torch.zeros(num_tokens, 2, dtype=torch.int32),
+            topk_weights=torch.full((num_tokens, 2), 0.5),
+        )
+
+    def agree(values, value, *, group):
+        values[:] = [value] * 2
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_gather_object", agree)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        torch.distributed, "broadcast_object_list", lambda *args, **kwargs: None
+    )
+    owners = []
+
+    def make(*, rank=0, sp_size=1, intermediate_size=8):
+        bootstrap = Bootstrap(rank=rank)
+        fleet = Fleet()
+        backend = Backend(megakernel=Kernel(intermediate_size=intermediate_size))
+        layer = RecordingLayer(bootstrap, fleet, None, backend)
+        profiles = FlashInferMoeEpProfiles(
+            layer, bootstrap, fleet, backend=backend, sp_size=sp_size
+        )
+        owners.append(profiles)
+        return profiles, layer
+
+    yield make, inputs, RecordingLayer
+    for owner in owners:
+        owner.destroy()
+
+
+def test_flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles_select_smallest_fitting_workspace(megamoe_profiles):
+    from vllm.forward_context import (
+        DPMetadata,
+        ForwardContext,
+        override_forward_context,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles import (
+        flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context,
+    )
+
+    make, inputs, _ = megamoe_profiles
+    profiles, layer = make()
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(decode_tokens=4, prefill_tokens=128):
+        profiles.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+
+    for num_tokens in (2, 4, 5):
+        profiles.forward(inputs(num_tokens), return_workspace_view=False)
+    context = ForwardContext(
+        no_compile_layers={},
+        attn_metadata={},
+        slot_mapping={},
+        dp_metadata=DPMetadata(torch.tensor([1, 4])),
+    )
+    with override_forward_context(context):
+        profiles.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+
+    assert layer.warmed_workspaces == [(4, 1), (4, 2), (4, 4), (128, 128)]
+    assert layer.selected_workspaces == [(4, 1), (4, 2), (4, 4), (128, 128), (4, 4)]
+
+
+def test_megamoe_startup_tunes_once_per_geometry_and_reuses_disk_cache(
+    megamoe_profiles, tmp_path
+):
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles import (
+        flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context,
+    )
+
+    make, inputs, service = megamoe_profiles
+    cache = tmp_path / "megamoe.json"
+    context_kwargs = dict(
+        decode_tokens=4,
+        prefill_tokens=16,
+        cache_file=cache,
+        cache_identity={"flashinfer": "test-version"},
+    )
+    first, first_layer = make()
+    second, second_layer = make()
+    different, _ = make(intermediate_size=16)
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(**context_kwargs):
+        for profiles in (first, second, different):
+            profiles.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+    expected = [(4, 1), (4, 2), (4, 4), (16, 16)]
+    assert service.tuned == expected * 2
+    assert first_layer.workspace_knobs == second_layer.workspace_knobs
+    assert cache.exists()
+    temporary = [layer for layer in service.instances if layer.backend.megakernel.knobs]
+    assert len(temporary) == 8 and all(layer.destroyed for layer in temporary)
+
+    hot, hot_layer = make()
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(**context_kwargs):
+        result = hot.forward(inputs(3), return_workspace_view=False)
+    assert torch.equal(result, inputs(3).hidden_states)
+    assert service.tuned == expected * 2
+    assert hot_layer.workspace_knobs == first_layer.workspace_knobs
+    assert hot_layer.selected_workspaces == [(4, 4)]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("leader_cache_hit", [False, True])
+def test_megamoe_ranks_follow_leader_cache_decision(
+    megamoe_profiles, monkeypatch, tmp_path, leader_cache_hit
+):
+    """Asymmetric files must not let one rank tune while its peers skip."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles import (
+        flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context,
+    )
+
+    make, inputs, service = megamoe_profiles
+    leader_cache = tmp_path / "leader.json"
+    peer_cache = tmp_path / "peer.json"
+    options = dict(decode_tokens=2, prefill_tokens=4, cache_identity={"version": 1})
+    primer, _ = make()
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(cache_file=leader_cache, **options):
+        primer.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+    if not leader_cache_hit:
+        leader_cache.rename(peer_cache)
+    service.tuned.clear()
+
+    rank = 0
+    broadcasts = []
+    received = 0
+
+    def broadcast(values, *, group, group_src):
+        nonlocal received
+        assert group_src == 0
+        if rank == 0:
+            broadcasts.append(deepcopy(values[0]))
+        else:
+            values[0] = deepcopy(broadcasts[received])
+            received += 1
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "is_initialized", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_world_size", lambda: 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda: rank)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "broadcast_object_list", broadcast)
+    previous_peer_cache = peer_cache.read_bytes() if peer_cache.exists() else None
+    layers = []
+    for rank, cache in enumerate((leader_cache, peer_cache)):
+        profiles, layer = make(rank=rank)
+        layers.append(layer)
+        with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(cache_file=cache, **options):
+            profiles.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+
+    assert received == len(broadcasts)
+    assert layers[0].workspace_knobs == layers[1].workspace_knobs
+    assert service.tuned == ([] if leader_cache_hit else [(2, 1), (2, 2), (4, 4)] * 2)
+    assert (
+        peer_cache.read_bytes() if peer_cache.exists() else None
+    ) == previous_peer_cache
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cache_state", ["corrupt", "environment_changed"])
+def test_megamoe_invalid_cache_retunes(megamoe_profiles, tmp_path, cache_state):
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles import (
+        flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context,
+    )
+
+    make, inputs, service = megamoe_profiles
+    cache = tmp_path / "megamoe.json"
+    options = dict(decode_tokens=2, prefill_tokens=4, cache_file=cache)
+    first, _ = make()
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(
+        cache_identity={"version": 1}, **options
+    ):
+        first.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+    if cache_state == "corrupt":
+        cache.write_text("{truncated")
+    identity = {"version": 2 if cache_state == "environment_changed" else 1}
+    second, second_layer = make()
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(cache_identity=identity, **options):
+        second.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+    assert service.tuned == [(2, 1), (2, 2), (4, 4)] * 2
+    assert second_layer.selected_workspaces == [(2, 1)]
+    assert json.loads(cache.read_text())["identity"]["environment"] == identity
+
+
+def test_megamoe_same_capacity_keeps_distinct_live_token_knobs(megamoe_profiles):
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles import (
+        flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context,
+    )
+
+    make, inputs, service = megamoe_profiles
+    profiles, layer = make()
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(decode_tokens=5, prefill_tokens=5):
+        profiles.forward(inputs(1), return_workspace_view=False)
+    for tokens in (2, 3, 5):
+        profiles.forward(inputs(tokens), return_workspace_view=False)
+    assert service.tuned == [(5, 1), (5, 2), (5, 4), (5, 5)]
+    assert layer.selected_workspaces == [(5, 1), (5, 2), (5, 4), (5, 5)]
+    assert layer.workspace_knobs[(5, 1)] != layer.workspace_knobs[(5, 2)]
+
+
+def test_megamoe_startup_destroys_temporary_tuner_on_failure(
+    megamoe_profiles, tmp_path
+):
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles import (
+        flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context,
+    )
+
+    make, inputs, service = megamoe_profiles
+    profiles, layer = make()
+    service.fail_profile = (4, 2)
+    cache = tmp_path / "failed.json"
+    with (
+        pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="external tuner failed"),
+        flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(
+            decode_tokens=4, prefill_tokens=16, cache_file=cache
+        ),

+@dataclass
+class _ProfileContext:
+    decode_tokens: int
+    prefill_tokens: int
+    records: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    dirty: bool = False
+
+
+_active_context: _ProfileContext | None = None
+_profile_owners: WeakSet[FlashInferMoeEpProfiles] = WeakSet()

+
+def has_flashinfer_moe_ep_profiles() -> bool:
+    """Whether this worker owns live-token workspaces with dynamic sizing."""
+    return bool(_profile_owners)
+
+
+def _runner_config(runner: Any, name: str) -> Any:
+    config = getattr(runner, name, None)
+    if config is not None:
+        return config
+    return getattr(runner.vllm_config, name)
+
+
+def _runner_limit(runner: Any, name: str, config_name: str) -> int:
+    value = getattr(runner, name, None)
+    if value is None:
+        value = getattr(_runner_config(runner, "scheduler_config"), config_name)
+    return int(value)
+
+
+def _decode_query_len(runner: Any) -> int:
+    for name in ("uniform_decode_query_len", "decode_query_len"):
+        value = getattr(runner, name, None)
+        if value is not None:
+            return max(1, int(value))
+    speculator = getattr(runner, "speculator", None)
+    return max(1, int(getattr(speculator, "num_query_per_req", 1)))
+
+
+def _decode_token_limit(runner: Any) -> int:
+    kv_config = runner.vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    if (
+        kv_config is not None
+        and kv_config.is_kv_producer
+        and not kv_config.is_kv_consumer
+    ):
+        return 1
+    # MRV1 materializes its final capture sizes on the runner. MRV2 keeps them
+    # on CompilationConfig until its CUDA Graph manager is initialized.
+    capture_sizes = getattr(runner, "cudagraph_batch_sizes", None)
+    if capture_sizes is None:
+        compilation_config = _runner_config(runner, "compilation_config")
+        capture_sizes = getattr(compilation_config, "cudagraph_capture_sizes", None)
+    if capture_sizes:
+        return max(int(size) for size in capture_sizes)
+    max_num_tokens = _runner_limit(runner, "max_num_tokens", "max_num_batched_tokens")
+    max_num_reqs = _runner_limit(runner, "max_num_reqs", "max_num_seqs")
+    return min(max_num_tokens, max_num_reqs * _decode_query_len(runner))
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(
+    *,
+    decode_tokens: int,
+    prefill_tokens: int,
+    cache_file: Path | None = None,
+    cache_identity: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Share tuning results across layers and persist them between startups."""
+    global _active_context
+    previous = _active_context
+    context = _ProfileContext(decode_tokens, prefill_tokens)
+    leader = not torch.distributed.is_initialized() or torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
+    identity = {"version": 1, "environment": cache_identity}
+    if cache_file is not None and leader:
+        try:
+            payload = json.loads(cache_file.read_text())
+            if (
+                isinstance(payload, dict)
+                and payload.get("identity") == identity
+                and isinstance(payload.get("records"), dict)
+            ):
+                context.records = payload["records"]
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            pass
+    _active_context = context
+    try:
+        yield
+        if cache_file is not None and leader and context.dirty:
+            from vllm.model_executor.warmup.flashinfer_autotune_cache import (
+                write_flashinfer_autotune_cache,
+            )
+
+            try:
+                write_flashinfer_autotune_cache(
+                    cache_file,
+                    json.dumps(
+                        {"identity": identity, "records": context.records},
+                        sort_keys=True,
+                    ).encode(),
+                )
+            except OSError:
+                logger.warning("Could not save MegaMoE tuning cache %s", cache_file)
+    finally:
+        _active_context = previous
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_context(runner: Any) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Prepare fixed workspaces before measuring serving memory requirements."""
+    import flashinfer
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.warmup.flashinfer_autotune_cache import (
+        resolve_flashinfer_autotune_file,
+    )
+
+    packages: dict[str, str | None] = {}
+    for package in ("nvidia-cutlass-dsl", "apache-tvm-ffi", "nvshmem4py-cu13"):
+        try:
+            packages[package] = version(package)
+        except PackageNotFoundError:
+            packages[package] = None
+    device = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    identity = {
+        "flashinfer": flashinfer.__version__,
+        "torch": torch.__version__,
+        "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
+        "device": [
+            device.name,
+            device.major,
+            device.minor,
+            device.multi_processor_count,
+        ],
+        "packages": packages,
+        "mega_use_ncu": os.environ.get("MEGA_USE_NCU", "0"),
+    }
+    with flashinfer_moe_ep_profile_token_context(
+        decode_tokens=_decode_token_limit(runner),
+        prefill_tokens=_runner_limit(
+            runner, "max_num_tokens", "max_num_batched_tokens"
+        ),
+        cache_file=resolve_flashinfer_autotune_file(runner).with_name(
+            "megamoe_knobs_v1.json"
+        ),
+        cache_identity=identity,
+    ):
+        yield
+
+
+class FlashInferMoeEpProfiles:
+    """Tune once per geometry and retain fixed workspaces for serving."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        layer: Any,
+        bootstrap: Any,
+        fleet: Any,
+        *,
+        backend: Any,
+        sp_size: int = 1,
+    ) -> None:
+        if sp_size < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"sp_size must be positive, got {sp_size}")
+        self.layer = layer
+        self.bootstrap = bootstrap
+        self.fleet = fleet
+        self.backend = backend
+        self.sp_size = sp_size
+        self.workspaces: dict[int, list[tuple[int, Any]]] = {}
+        self.capacities: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+        _profile_owners.add(self)
+
+    def destroy(self) -> None:
+        """Release workspace handles and remove this owner from memory planning."""
+        _profile_owners.discard(self)
+        self.workspaces.clear()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def is_supported(layer: Any) -> bool:
+        create = getattr(layer, "create_workspace", None)
+        if not callable(create) or not callable(
+            getattr(layer, "get_tuned_knobs", None)
+        ):
+            return False
+        return {"live_tokens", "knobs"} <= signature(create).parameters.keys()
+
+    def _broadcast(self, value: Any) -> Any:
+        if self.bootstrap.world_size == 1:
+            return value
+        values = [value]
+        torch.distributed.broadcast_object_list(
+            values, group=self.bootstrap.process_group, group_src=0
+        )
+        return values[0]
+
+    def _profile_key(self, capacity: int, tokens: int) -> str:
+        config = self.backend.megakernel
+        settings = {
+            item.name: (
+                getattr(config, item.name).value
+                if isinstance(getattr(config, item.name), Enum)
+                else getattr(config, item.name)
+            )
+            for item in fields(config)
+            if item.name
+            not in {
+                "knobs",
+                "input_norm_const",
+                "fc1_alpha",
+                "fc2_alpha",
+                "fc1_norm_const",
+            }
+        }
+        return json.dumps(
+            {
+                "backend": type(config).__name__,
+                "settings": settings,
+                "quantize_input": self.backend.quantize_input,
+                "world_size": self.bootstrap.world_size,
+                "hidden": self.fleet.token_hidden_size,
+                "experts": self.fleet.num_experts,
+                "capacity": capacity,
+                "live_tokens": tokens,
+            },
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+
+    def _tune(self, tensors: Any, capacity: int, tokens: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        temporary = type(self.layer)(
+            self.bootstrap,
+            replace(
+                self.fleet, max_tokens_per_rank=capacity, tuning_live_tokens=tokens
+            ),
+            None,
+            replace(
+                self.backend,
+                megakernel=replace(self.backend.megakernel, knobs="auto"),
+            ),
+        )
+        try:
+            temporary.warmup(tensors)
+            return temporary.get_tuned_knobs()
+        finally:
+            temporary.destroy()
+
+    def _agree(self, value: Any) -> None:
+        if self.bootstrap.world_size == 1:
+            return
+        values = [None] * self.bootstrap.world_size
+        torch.distributed.all_gather_object(
+            values, value, group=self.bootstrap.process_group
+        )
+        if any(item != values[0] for item in values):
+            raise RuntimeError("MegaMoE ranks selected different workspace profiles")
+
+    def _profile_inputs(self, tensors: Any, tokens: int) -> Any:
+        count = tensors.num_tokens
+
+        def resize(tensor: torch.Tensor | None) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+            if tensor is None:
+                return None
+            if count == 0:
+                return tensor.new_zeros((tokens, *tensor.shape[1:]))
+            if tokens <= count:
+                return tensor[:tokens]
+            repeats = ((tokens + count - 1) // count,) + (1,) * (tensor.ndim - 1)
+            return tensor.repeat(repeats)[:tokens]
+
+        if count == 0:
+            hidden = tensors.hidden_states.new_zeros(
+                tokens, self.fleet.token_hidden_size
+            )
+            top_k = tensors.topk_ids.shape[1]
+            ids = (
+                torch.arange(
+                    tokens * top_k,
+                    dtype=tensors.topk_ids.dtype,
+                    device=hidden.device,
+                ).view(tokens, top_k)
+                % self.fleet.num_experts
+            )
+            weights = tensors.topk_weights.new_full(ids.shape, 1.0 / top_k)
+        else:
+            hidden = resize(tensors.hidden_states)
+            ids = resize(tensors.topk_ids)
+            weights = resize(tensors.topk_weights)
+        assert hidden is not None and ids is not None and weights is not None
+        return replace(
+            tensors,
+            hidden_states=hidden,
+            topk_ids=ids,
+            topk_weights=weights,
+            scales=resize(tensors.scales),
+            output=None,
+        )
+
+    def _prepare(self, tensors: Any) -> None:
+        context = _active_context
+        if context is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("MegaMoE profiles require the startup profile context")
+
+        if (
+            torch.distributed.is_initialized()
+            and self.bootstrap.world_size != torch.distributed.get_world_size()
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("MegaMoE startup tuning requires EP to span WORLD")
+        decode = max(1, cdiv(context.decode_tokens, self.sp_size))
+        prefill = max(1, cdiv(context.prefill_tokens, self.sp_size))
+        self.capacities = tuple(sorted({decode, prefill}))
+        self._agree(self.capacities)
+        for capacity in self.capacities:
+            buckets = {capacity}
+            if capacity == decode:
+                buckets.update(1 << i for i in range(decode.bit_length()))
+            live_buckets = tuple(sorted(buckets))
+            self._agree((capacity, live_buckets))
+            handles = []
+            for live_tokens in live_buckets:
+                inputs = self._profile_inputs(tensors, live_tokens)
+                key = self._profile_key(capacity, live_tokens)
+                knobs = self._broadcast(
+                    context.records.get(key) if self.bootstrap.rank == 0 else None
+                )
+                if not isinstance(knobs, dict) or not knobs:
+                    knobs = self._broadcast(self._tune(inputs, capacity, live_tokens))
+                    if not isinstance(knobs, dict) or not knobs:
+                        raise RuntimeError(
+                            "MegaMoE autotune returned no selected knobs"
+                        )
+                    context.records[key] = knobs
+                    context.dirty = True
+                # FlashInfer tactics contain tuple-valued tile/cluster shapes.
+                knobs = {
+                    name: tuple(value) if isinstance(value, list) else value
+                    for name, value in knobs.items()
+                }
+                workspace = self.layer.create_workspace(
+                    capacity, live_tokens=live_tokens, knobs=knobs
+                )
+                self.layer.warmup(inputs, workspace=workspace)
+                handles.append((live_tokens, workspace))
+            self.workspaces[capacity] = handles
+
+    def _token_count(self, local_rows: int) -> int:
+        if self.bootstrap.world_size == 1:
+            return local_rows
+        if not is_forward_context_available():
+            return local_rows
+        metadata = get_forward_context().dp_metadata
+        if metadata is None:
+            return local_rows
+        if metadata.local_sizes is not None:
+            return max(metadata.local_sizes)
+        return cdiv(int(metadata.num_tokens_across_dp_cpu.max()), self.sp_size)
+
+    def _workspace(self, capacity: int, tokens: int) -> Any:
+        handles = self.workspaces[capacity]
+        buckets = [bucket for bucket, _ in handles]
+        index = bisect_left(buckets, tokens)
+        if index == len(handles):
+            index -= 1
+        return handles[index][1]
+
+    def forward(self, tensors: Any, *, return_workspace_view: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not self.workspaces:
+            if _active_context is None:
+                return self.layer.forward(
+                    tensors, return_workspace_view=return_workspace_view
+                )
+            if torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "MegaMoE workspace setup must finish before CUDA Graph capture"
+                )
+            self._prepare(tensors)
+
+        count = self._token_count(tensors.num_tokens)
+        index = bisect_left(self.capacities, max(count, 1))
+        if index == len(self.capacities):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"MegaMoE received {count} rows beyond prepared {self.capacities}"
+            )
+        capacity = self.capacities[index]
+        return self.layer.forward(
+            tensors,
+            workspace=self._workspace(capacity, count),
+            return_workspace_view=return_workspace_view,
+        )
